title: Perfect fluid equations with nonrelativistic conformal supersymmetries
summary: Our recent result on the construction of perfect fluid equations with N=1,2 Schrödinger supersymmetry [Mod. Phys. Lett. A 41 (2026) 2550214] is extended to accommodate nonrelativistic conformal supersymmetries of other types. Two cases are considered in detail, which include the N=2 conformal Newton-Hooke superalgebra and N=1 l-conformal Galilei superalgebra with arbitrary half-integer parameter l.
